measure_definitions.label: Revenue over a completed period
measure_definitions.note: Completed years, half-years and trailing years are separate cohorts.

measure_definitions.label: Annualized revenue snapshots
measure_definitions.note: Dated pace; not recognized annual revenue or proven recurring ARR.

measure_definitions.label: Year-over-year revenue growth
measure_definitions.note: Matching revenue periods and scope; source-reported and calculated figures retain their distinction.

measure_definitions.label: Statutory net income / loss
measure_definitions.note: After-tax profit or loss, kept separate from adjusted EBITDA.

measure_definitions.label: Statutory net margin
measure_definitions.note: Net income / revenue for the same company scope and period.

measure_definitions.label: Adjusted EBITDA
measure_definitions.note: Issuer-defined non-GAAP earnings; not statutory profit or cash flow.

measure_definitions.label: Adjusted EBITDA margin
measure_definitions.note: Issuer-adjusted EBITDA / revenue; not gross margin or statutory net margin.

measure_definitions.label: Gross margin
measure_definitions.note: Revenue after direct cost of sales; source group scope remains explicit.

measure_definitions.label: Reported pre-tax income / loss
measure_definitions.note: Before-tax profit or loss; distinct from net income after tax.

measure_definitions.label: Attributed profitability statements
measure_definitions.note: Qualitative statements with no comparable numeric profit amount.

measure_definitions.label: Net revenue retention
measure_definitions.note: Repeat-customer revenue, including expansion, under the issuer definition.

measure_definitions.label: Top-five customer revenue share
measure_definitions.note: Higher share means more buyer concentration; not a customer satisfaction score.

measure_definitions.label: Reported customer / organization count
measure_definitions.note: Reach context; not necessarily active paying customers or repeat demand.

measure_definitions.label: Daily expert payouts
measure_definitions.note: One-day operating snapshot; no automatic annualization.

measure_definitions.label: Cumulative expert / participant payouts
measure_definitions.note: Lifetime volume at different dates; not a current delivery rate.

measure_definitions.label: Cumulative delivered work hours
measure_definitions.note: Lifetime work volume; no comparable utilization period.

measure_definitions.label: Payout claim with unclear period basis
measure_definitions.note: Context only; actual versus forecast or year-to-date basis is unclear.

measure_definitions.label: Expert network reach
measure_definitions.note: Registration/vetting/marketing pool; not comparable monthly active paid experts.

measure_definitions.label: Cash and cash equivalents
measure_definitions.note: Liquidity snapshot; debt, restrictions and forward cash burn are needed to estimate runway.

measure_definitions.label: Net debt
measure_definitions.note: Debt less cash under the issuer definition; different from cash on hand.

measure_definitions.label: Reported team size
measure_definitions.note: Employee, teammate and directory snapshots are cost/capacity context, not a health ranking.

measure_definitions.label: Net operating cash flow
measure_definitions.note: Net cash from operating activities as reported; working-capital movements affect the result.

measure_definitions.label: Free cash flow
measure_definitions.note: Issuer-defined non-GAAP cash flow; definitions may differ. Kept separate from adjusted free cash flow.

measure_definitions.label: Contribution hours over a stated period
measure_definitions.note: Contribution volume; paid status and exact reporting cutoff may be undisclosed.

measure_definitions.label: Studies and tasks over a stated period
measure_definitions.note: Tasks vary in duration and complexity. Not active paid experts or revenue.

methodology.calculations: Calculated observations retain formula, input observation IDs and original evidence. No interpolated revenue series, invented active-worker counts or undisclosed-margin estimates are presented as facts.
cohorts: Match period.type, period.year, currency, scope and accounting_basis before comparing revenue levels or calculating growth.
Annualized revenue is a dated pace, not recognized annual revenue or subscription ARR.
Whole-company, parent, AI Services and other-segment observations remain labelled separately.
Qualifiers are retained: greater_than/at_least are lower bounds, nearly is not an exact value, approximate remains approximate.
Missing disclosure is not zero and is not evidence that a business is unhealthy. Nonprofit research entities are not commercial vendors.
methodology.estimates: No new financial estimate is invented for missing data. A defensible future estimate must carry a range, explicit assumptions, date, scope and source inputs, and be switchable independently from reported observations.
methodology.freshness: Selected financial statements and company disclosures were read on 28 October 2026. Each source check records its outcome separately from the reporting period. Other observations retain the October 15 research review; a page retrieval does not verify every claim. A second primary-source pass added separately dated company operating statements and corrected estimate/accounting-basis classifications; unavailable revenue sources remain flagged.
methodology.selection: Supported canonical claims plus separately documented fresh source excerpts for new interim financial observations. New observations preserve their exact period, scope, units and source checks; the underlying canonical release is unchanged.

north_star.definition: Revenue from returning paying customers, less the direct cost of delivering their work, measured over a consistent period.
north_star.label: Gross profit from repeat customers
north_star.limitation: The reviewed sources do not disclose a comparable repeat-customer gross-profit series across this universe. No health score is assigned; the five signals and their gaps are shown instead.
north_star.why: It combines repeat demand with the value the company keeps after paying for delivery. Gross billings, funding and registrations can rise while the underlying business weakens.

signals.ideal_measure: Same-scope recognized revenue and year-over-year growth over matching periods.
signals.interpretation: Revenue measures customer spending; growth reveals momentum. Gross and net recognition must be separated.
signals.label: Revenue & growth
signals.limitations: Run-rate snapshots, full-year results, partial years, forecasts and parent/segment results are separate cohorts.
signals.question: Is paid demand growing?

signals.ideal_measure: Gross profit and gross margin; confirm with statutory profit and cash conversion.
signals.interpretation: Revenue can grow without profitable unit economics. A positive adjusted EBITDA figure can coexist with a statutory loss.
signals.label: Profit & margins
signals.limitations: Gross margin, statutory net margin, pre-tax profit and adjusted EBITDA have different definitions and are not ranked together.
signals.question: Does the company keep money after delivery?

signals.ideal_measure: Net revenue retention, repeat-customer share and largest/top-five revenue concentration.
signals.interpretation: Expansion and repeat spend are stronger evidence than a logo wall. Concentration exposes dependence on a few buyers.
signals.label: Customer durability
signals.limitations: Customer counts are explicitly labelled reach proxies. Named research partners, platform signups and unknown paid-status logos are not paying-customer counts.
signals.question: Do customers return, and how concentrated is demand?

signals.ideal_measure: Monthly paid active experts, accepted delivery hours/tasks, payout volume and utilization.
signals.interpretation: Paid throughput is closer to productive supply than a registered expert network.
signals.label: Paid delivery
signals.limitations: Daily snapshots, lifetime payouts and registered networks stay separate. No comparable monthly active paid-expert count is established in the reviewed records.
signals.question: Is the expert supply actually doing paid work?

signals.ideal_measure: Operating/free cash flow and months of runway from unrestricted cash divided by a defensible forward cash-burn estimate.
signals.interpretation: A growing business still needs liquidity. Employee counts describe delivery or cost capacity, not business health on their own.
signals.label: Cash & resilience
signals.limitations: Funding raised is not cash on hand. Net losses are not cash burn. Cash, net debt and company/team snapshots are separate context and do not establish runway.
signals.question: Can the business fund its next stage?

source_checks.notes: Selected financial source documents were retrieved and read on 28 October 2026. Individual entries distinguish content checks, page availability and failed retrieval. This is a partial refresh, not a new audit of all 39 companies. TaskUs Q3 results are scheduled for 4 November. Second pass reviewed private-company primary news indexes; no newer revenue is inferred from product announcements, funding, commitments or network reach.

rubric.notes: P = product / delivered offer; C = customer / adoption; R = repeatability / commercial continuity; O = operating readiness. Company-wide evidence does not automatically establish AI-data-segment maturity.
